notes.title: Seven Deadly Dates Art Contest!!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42335750/b806556551f2286592c7c14c22125d90b9d23427.png[/img]


An art contest has just begun for seven deadly dates! You can draw your favourite girl from SDD and get a chance to win an acrylic figure, set of stickers, and a FREE copy of the game + Artbook DLC!!

Please read the rules and info so you know how you can submit your piece!!!!

[url=https://twitter.com/MythiKiwi/status/1547741217244741632]INFO AND RULES TWITTER POST CLICK HERE~![/url]
